response: Yes, the menopausal transition can significantly affect a woman's quality of life. Symptoms such as hot flashes, night sweats, mood changes, sleep disturbances, and vaginal dryness can impact daily activities, relationships, and overall well-being. Additionally, the transition can also lead to changes in physical health, emotional health, and sexual function, further affecting quality of life. However, many of these symptoms can be managed with lifestyle changes, hormone therapy, and other treatments, which can help improve quality of life during this transition.
